data.name: Nazeehah
data.short_meaning: giver of good advice, kind, helpful
data.long_meaning: The one who gives good advice, kind, and helpful. It is derived from the Arabic verb 'nazahaha' which means 'to advise, to caution, to suggest, to admonish'. This name signifies a person who is always ready to help and guide others, and is known for her kindness and generosity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nazeehah represents the inner wisdom and guidance that comes from a connection to the divine. It symbolizes the ability to listen to the voice of intuition and to offer sound advice to others based on this inner knowledge. This name is a reminder to be kind, compassionate, and helpful in all aspects of life.

in_arabic.name: نَزِيحَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: تعود تسمية نَزِيحَة إلى الأصل اللغوي النَزِيح-ة، الذي يشتق من الجذر نَزَا-هَا، ويحمل معاني الخير والمبادرة، والتقدُّم في الفعل، والخير والفضيلة، ويعتبر اسم نَزِيحَة مصدراً للفعل النَزِيح، وتُعتبر نَزِيحَة إحدى الأسماء النبوية، حيث قيل أنّ النبي محمد ﷺ كان يُدعى نَزِيحَة، ويعتبر هذا الاسم من أسماء الصالحين، وقد شاع استخدام هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي، ويعتبر نَزِيحَة اسماً مقدساً في الثقافة الإسلامية، ويعكس قيم الخير والمبادرة والخير في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: نزیہہ
in_urdu.meaning: خیر کی طرف قدم کرنے والی اور اسمیں بھی مدد کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: نزیہہ نام کا آغاز نزيه-ہ سے ہوتا ہے، جو نز-ا-ہا سے مشتق ہے، اور اس کے معنی خیر کی طرف قدم کرنے والی اور اس میں مدد کرنے والی ہے، نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کو بھی نزیہہ کہا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام صالحین کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، تاریخ اسلام میں اس نام کی بھی اہمیت ہے، اور یہ نام اسلام کی ثقافت میں مقدس ہے، اور یہ بھی ظاہر کرتا ہے کہ اسلام میں خیر اور خیر کی طرف قدم کرنا بہت اہم ہے

The name Nazeehah is also mentioned in the Quran, where it is described as a name that is dear to Allah. In Islamic culture, the name Nazeehah is considered a symbol of piety and benevolence, and it is often given to girls born into Muslim families. The name Nazeehah is also associated with positive personality traits such as kindness, generosity, and compassion. In modern times, the name Nazeehah has become popular among Muslim parents who want to give their child a name that reflects their Islamic values and traditions

It embodies the Islamic virtue of kindness and helping others in need. In many Islamic societies, helping and advising others is highly regarded as an important aspect of being a good Muslim. Furthermore, it is often associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) saying, "The best of people are those who bring most benefit to mankind." Nazeehah, as someone who is constantly offering good advice and help, embodies this virtue and inspires those around her to do the same.
data.spiritual_significance: Nazeehah's name carries deep spiritual significance for Muslims as it reminds them of the importance of advising and helping others, not just in word but also in deed. In Islamic teachings, advising and helping others is a way to seek Allah's pleasure and to build a strong community where people look out for one another. This is also in line with the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) sayings, "Allah's curse be upon him who passes by a Muslim in need but does not help him." and "The strong is not the one who overcomes the people by his strength, but the strong is the one who controls himself while in anger." By giving the name Nazeehah to a child, parents are hoping to instill these virtues in the child and help her grow up to be a kind, helpful, and compassionate person.
